goal: Protect nodes against memory exhaustion and CPU denial of service from crafted blocks
Drastically reduces memory and deserialization time for blocks with huge numbers of witness items
agreement: Broad concept support with no open objections
Concept approval noting exceptional transaction types cause issues in multiple areas (instagibbs)
Concept approval without detailed comments (furszy, 0xB10C, w0xlt, rkrux)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it neutralizes a message-processing denial of service from crafted 4 MB blocks
Rejects malformed transactions missing inputs or outputs without disconnecting peers

categories.name: validation
why: P1 because it eliminates a severe validation denial of service vector
Blocks with millions of tiny witness items drop from over 110 MB memory allocation to 4 MB
Deserialization latency on worst-case blocks drops from over 300 ms to under 20 ms
